clue.text: Organisation had room in building in town centre

parts.note: a guild is an organisation of craftsmen or merchants
a hall is a large room

explanation.surface: Some body held a meeting in a room in a central town building.
explanation.definitionFit: A guildhall is the civic hall where a town's council or guilds meet, usually a central landmark.

clue.text: Georgia had milky acid, it's to do with the milky way!

definitions.text: to do with the milky way

parts.note: GA is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Georgia
lactic acid is the acid found in sour milk

explanation.surface: A Georgian drank curdled milk, an astronomical matter, the clue jokes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'had' is only a link joining the two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Galactic describes anything belonging to a galaxy, and the Milky Way is our own galaxy.

clue.text: I am stiffly formal before one's in the first place

indicators.note: before puts the formal word ahead of the next piece in the answer

parts.note: I am contracts to I'M
prim means stiffly proper and formal
one is I in Roman numerals, and the 's adds S

explanation.surface: Someone says they are stiff and formal ahead of a person's turn.
explanation.definitionFit: Imprimis is Latin for firstly, used when listing points in order.

clue.text: It can be done as before having enough strength

parts.note: do is short for ditto, meaning the same as before
able means having the power or capacity to do something

explanation.surface: A task can be managed as in the past if you are strong enough.
explanation.definitionFit: Something achievable or feasible is a thing that can be carried out.

clue.text: Fan did wrong breaking law

indicators.note: breaking means splitting the law word open to hold the other letters

parts.note: an act is a law passed by Parliament

indicators.note: wrong signals the letters of did are put out of order

explanation.surface: A supporter committed an offence by breaking the law.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wrong' turns DID into DDI, and 'breaking' puts DDI inside ACT.
explanation.definitionFit: An enthusiast devoted to some pursuit is called an addict, as in a jazz addict.

clue.text: Left cricketer before first innings in charge pouring out wine

indicators.note: first asks for the opening letter of innings only

parts.note: a bat is a batsman, a cricketer who bats
an ion is a particle carrying an electric charge

explanation.surface: A left-handed batsman pours out wine before his first innings in charge.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface order is loose: I (first of 'innings') must go between L and BAT, with ION last; 'before' and 'in' only join the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A libation is an offering of wine poured out, as to a god.

clue.text: Abatement of the lease?

explanation.surface: A tenant hopes the lease will offer some reduction.
explanation.walkthrough: The second reading is whimsical: when a lease (a let) has expired, the let is up.
explanation.definitionFit: A pause or slackening is a lessening, and a let that has run out has ended; both senses share the phrase.

clue.text: Fifty suffering lose strength

parts.note: L is fifty in Roman numerals
anguish is severe suffering

explanation.surface: Fifty people in pain grow weaker.
explanation.definitionFit: To languish is to weaken or decline, losing vigour.

clue.text: Want to have a drink with this

definitions.text: Want to have a drink with this

parts.words: Want to have a drink with this
parts.note: the craving you feel when dry is what makes you wish for a drink; want here is a noun, a need

explanation.definitionFit: A dry throat creates the need for liquid, which is exactly a desire to drink.

clue.text: We are all members of it

definitions.text: We are all members of it

parts.words: We are all members of it
parts.note: sounds like a club or society, but it is the whole population taken together

explanation.definitionFit: The general people form a body that every citizen belongs to.

clue.text: Youngster included chart of northern region

indicators.note: included means the youngster word holds the chart word inside it

parts.note: a lad is a boy, a youngster
a plan is a map or chart

explanation.surface: A boy brought along a map of the far north.
explanation.definitionFit: Lapland is the Arctic area of Scandinavia and Finland, a far northern territory.

clue.text: This speech starting during summer month by the river

parts.note: in means during, as in in the night
Aug is short for August, a summer month in the north
the Ural is a river in Russia and Kazakhstan

explanation.surface: A speech begins in August beside a river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'by' only joins the river to the month.
explanation.definitionFit: An opening address given at a beginning, such as a president's first speech, is called an inaugural.

clue.text: Violent wind during play

explanation.surface: A gale blew during the performance.
explanation.definitionFit: A storm with strong gusts is a tempest, and Shakespeare's drama of that name is a famous stage work.

clue.text: Another indication Ann left is foolish

indicators.note: another signals a different arrangement of the letters of indication

parts.note: the name is taken as written

explanation.surface: A further sign that Ann has gone shows she is silly.
explanation.walkthrough: Take ANN away ('left') from the letters of INDICATION; 'Another' rearranges what remains.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiotic and foolish are synonyms, both meaning very stupid.

clue.text: Flying fortresses?

parts.note: suggests wartime bombers, but means strongholds floating in the sky, a picture of daydreams

explanation.definitionFit: Unrealistic plans or fantasies are imagined strongholds aloft, an idiom for daydreams.

clue.text: Lingering farewell on the radio

parts.note: long can mean lasting or lingering
a wave is a farewell gesture of the hand

explanation.surface: A drawn-out goodbye is broadcast.
explanation.definitionFit: Long wave is a broadcasting band, so programmes are heard over it on a receiver.

clue.text: Day saint became devil-worshipper

parts.note: Sat is short for Saturday, a day

indicators.note: became signals the letters of saint turning into something else

explanation.surface: One day a holy person turned to Satan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'became' rearranges SAINT into ANIST, after SAT.
explanation.definitionFit: A follower of Satan worships the Devil.

clue.text: Spreading fear about weapon hidden inside a catalogue

indicators.note: hidden inside means the weapon word is placed within the other letters

parts.note: a list is a catalogue
an arm is a weapon, as in firearms

explanation.surface: Panic spreads about a gun concealed in a list.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hidden inside' puts ARM inside A + LIST; 'about' only joins.
explanation.definitionFit: An alarmist person or warning causes needless panic.

clue.text: Cut back engineers' ditch

parts.note: RE stands for the Royal Engineers, a British Army corps
a trench is a ditch

explanation.surface: The engineers' ditch was cut back.
explanation.definitionFit: To retrench is to reduce spending, economise.

clue.text: Fitting stabbing instrument

explanation.surface: An apt weapon for stabbing.
explanation.definitionFit: A bayonet fitting is a push-and-twist connector, as on light bulbs, and a bayonet is a blade fixed to a rifle.

clue.text: Accused of causing riotous bedlam

indicators.note: riotous suggests disorder, so the letters of bedlam are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone was charged with creating uproar.
explanation.definitionFit: Being held responsible for something is being blamed for it.

clue.text: Cowardly shout, painful one

parts.note: yell means shout
ow is a cry of pain, a painful exclamation

explanation.surface: A coward cries out after being hurt.
explanation.definitionFit: Yellow is slang for lacking courage.

clue.text: Salesman had the French book put into another bed

parts.note: a rep is a sales representative
la is French for the (feminine)
NT is the New Testament, a book of the Bible

explanation.surface: A salesman owned a French book about gardening.
explanation.definitionFit: To replant a seedling is to move it to a new flower bed.

clue.text: Lots of paper said to be from the city

indicators.note: said to be signals the word spoken out loud gives the answer

parts.note: reams are large quantities of paper, 500 sheets each

explanation.surface: Quantities of paper reportedly came from a town.
explanation.definitionFit: Rheims is a city in Champagne, northeast France.

clue.text: Matter filled space at general assembly

explanation.surface: Material occupied space at a big meeting.
explanation.definitionFit: In physics a plenum is a space full of matter, and it is also a meeting attended by all members.

clue.text: Deduction for pension

explanation.surface: Tax relief on retirement income.
explanation.definitionFit: A tax allowance is an amount subtracted before tax, and a regular sum paid to someone is an allowance.

clue.text: Local indicator

parts.note: local is British slang for one's nearby pub, and the indicator is the board that marks it

explanation.definitionFit: A pub's hanging board, painted with its name, shows where the local is.

clue.text: So we'd organised search for underground water

indicators.note: organised suggests putting the letters of so we'd into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Thus we would arrange a hunt for hidden springs.
explanation.definitionFit: To dowse is to search for water with a divining rod.

clue.text: Try striker in international

parts.note: test means try out
a match is struck to light it

explanation.surface: A player tries out as a forward in a national team.
explanation.definitionFit: A test match is a cricket or rugby game between national sides, an international fixture.
